Definitions.Query: 3 process pairs, alternating before/after; 3 warmups + 10 samples per scenario; Stopwatch excludes corpus creation
Definitions.UI: 3 process pairs; each sample is 20 repeated filter-sort-reconcile paints after 3 warmups; ListCollectionView, no on-screen window
Definitions.Cancelled: 3 process pairs; 60000 prepared ranks; 3 uncancelled warmups + 20 already-cancelled calls; reflection calls the real method in each DLL
Definitions.Allocation: GC.GetTotalAllocatedBytes(true) delta per process workload, divided by iterations in summary; not live heap or peak memory
Definitions.P95: Nearest rank ceil(n * 0.95); UI has only 3 aggregate samples, so its P95 is its maximum aggregate
Definitions.Signature: SHA256 of final sample ordered Path|IsDir|RankSortKey for index; ordered FullPath for UI
